summary.text: Katie Kazarian is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 63 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She began serving as House majority leader in May 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kazarian earned a bachelor's degree in Urban Studies and Economics from Columbia University in 2012.
